text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday. —I prepared a board game 
as a present."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, Air Groove-san. What kind 
of game is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I recall... the sales pitch said, "To 
dominate the board, you must skillfully 
bewilder your opponent with words."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? I'll have to check the summary 
later. Judging by the phrase 
'glib-tongued,' there might be a specific 
role involved... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, the outcome is obvious. The moment 
you stepped onto the same board—it was 
checkmate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoever it may be, they will dance in the 
palm of my hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Having confidence is fine 
and all, but it can also lead to 
carelessness. Are you keeping that in 
mind?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. In that case, care to test it out? 
If you can beat me, I'll do whatever you 
say.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In the world of competition, you never 
know what might happen. If you act too 
complacent, you lose sight of your 
surroundings and might find yourself left 
behind before you even realize it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In your case, that has already become a 
bad habit. An attitude like that will end 
up affecting your races, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, you didn't have to go and snap at 
me out of nowhere like that..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
U-Ugh... Even though it's my birthday... I 
hate this... I want to go home...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...*sigh* Alright, alright. I'll save the 
lecture for after our match. Honestly, 
you're a handful."
